name: createInbox
label: Create an Inbox
description: Creates an inbox on the managed domain or a verified custom domain.

name: listInboxes
label: List Inboxes
description: Lists the inboxes belonging to the connected account.

name: sendEmail
label: Send an Email
description: Sends an email from a SentFromAI inbox.

name: replyToEmail
label: Reply to an Email
description: Replies in the original thread; SentFromAI derives recipients and threading headers.

name: getEmail
label: Get an Email
description: Retrieves a message with body, labels, and signed attachment URLs.

name: searchEmails
label: Search Emails
description: Searches up to 100 messages; each matching message becomes a bundle.

name: watchReceivedEmails
label: Watch Received Emails
description: Polls the latest 100 messages for incoming email. Schedule frequently enough to stay within that window.

name: makeApiCall
label: Make an API Call
description: Makes an authenticated request to the SentFromAI API.
